$comment: One regex list for the four noise families. Patterns use only syntax shared by the JavaScript RegExp engine and Python's re, and are matched case-insensitively. Each pattern carries three scope flags: `answer` (a writer composing an answer on someone's behalf), `copy` (outward product copy, which is the scope the page lint uses) and `reply` (a chat reply). Family 2 is scoped out of `copy` on purpose: a landing page is not answering a question about experience.
rule: NO NOISE. When a question asks about experience with a specific thing and there is none, the whole answer is "No experience." (a years field: 0; a yes/no field: No). When there is experience, state the fact at the length the field asks for. Never pivot to a compensating strength, an adjacent tool, or what would be learned, unless the question asked for strengths. Never announce sincerity. Never say no without the word. Never narrate the answer: write the thing the frame was announcing.
copy_rule: NO FILLER NOISE. Product copy states what the product does and what happened, in plain nouns and verbs. Banned in any wording: "designed to", "built to help", "seamlessly", "effortlessly", "powerful", "robust", "cutting-edge", "next-generation", "game-changing", "streamline", "elevate", "unlock", "empower", "supercharge", "take X to the next level", "whether you're X or Y", "in today's fast-paced world", "say goodbye to", a lead "No more X", "we're excited to", "thrilled to announce", a lead "Introducing", "the ultimate", "your one-stop", "hassle-free", "peace of mind", "at your fingertips", "look no further", any question used as a hook, and any sentence that could be pasted onto a different product unchanged. If a sentence would still be true with the product name swapped for another product, delete it.

1.name: performed-sincerity
1.title: PERFORMED SINCERITY
1.what: a phrase announcing that the speaker is being honest instead of being honest

2.name: euphemism-for-no
2.title: EUPHEMISM FOR NO
2.what: saying no without the word; the answer to "experience with X?" when there is none is "No experience." or "None."

3.name: narrating-the-answer
3.title: NARRATING THE ANSWER
3.what: a sentence about the speaker's stance toward the answer instead of the answer

4.name: filler-noise
4.title: FILLER NOISE IN PRODUCT COPY
4.what: describing a product or feature with padding instead of what it does; the product stands on what it does
